# ml-tlv.com

> ml-tlv is Israel's leading online platform for purchasing authentic luxury niche perfume samples (decants) in 2ml, 5ml, and 10ml glass atomizers.

## Key Facts
- All perfumes are sourced exclusively from official importers — 100% original guaranteed
- Sterile decanting process using disposable syringes, directly from original bottles with no human contact
- Over 100 luxury niche brands including Xerjoff, Creed, Roja, Amouage, Initio, MFK, Parfums de Marly, Nishane, and more
- Ships nationwide across Israel within 7 business days via UPS
- Free pickup available from North Tel Aviv
- Glass atomizer vials with high-quality spray mechanism
- Available volumes: 2ml (~25-30 sprays), 5ml (~75 sprays), 10ml (~150 sprays)
- Bonus samples included with orders over ₪300, ₪500, and ₪1000

## About
ml-tlv was founded in 2023 in Tel Aviv with the mission of making luxury niche perfumes accessible to fragrance enthusiasts in Israel. Instead of committing to expensive full bottles, customers can explore a wide variety of exclusive scents through affordable sample sizes. Every decant is prepared in sterile conditions to preserve the original fragrance profile.
